name: Metin Akdülger
bio:
Metin Akdülger (born 10 April 1988) is a Turkish actor, writer, musician. He is co-writer of comic book series "Görmüş Geçirmiş Kaptan 88". His music band is "Journers".

He is best known for his performances in Medcezir (2013-2015), Muhteşem Yüzyıl: Kösem (2015-2017), My Favourite Fabric (2018), Persona (2018), Atiye (2019). In addition to feature films, Akdülger has played in many short films throughout his career and has been a judge in many short film competitions. In late 2019, he formed the band Journers with Burak Yeşildurak and started making music.
